description:
The Whimsy bike’s bold purple frame shines with glittery graphics and a sleek design. Built with a durable steel frame and backed by a limited lifetime warranty, this bike is made for magical rides that last.
The die-cut pink mag wheels bring a bold, stylish touch while offering a strong and low-maintenance design. Paired with grippy white tires, they ensure a smooth and confident ride on every adventure.
The fully enclosed chainguard keeps clothes and little legs safe while adding a dazzling touch with its swirling starry design. Practical and magical, it’s built for fun and worry-free riding.
The bold handlebar plaque features swirling stars and the Whimsy name, adding a touch of magic to every adventure. Paired with glittery streamers, this bike is as fun to ride as it is to show off.
The padded seat features a whimsical starry design for extra flair, while the easy-adjust seatpost ensures the perfect fit as your child grows. Every ride is a comfortable adventure!

components.description: Dual Braking System for Control: Front handbrake and rear coaster brake allow for easy stopping and confident handling.
